children: Logitech G, the high-performance gaming gear division of Logitech International
has been named the Official Steering Wheel Partner for SEGA’s upcoming title,

, SEGA has joined Logitech G’s Developer Alliance, giving the studio direct access to hardware integration tools to optimize gameplay across Logitech G’s wheel lineup, including the G923, RS50, and PRO Racing Wheel.

The integration incorporates Logitech G’s Direct Drive motors and proprietary TRUEFORCE™ haptic feedback technology, designed to simulate force feedback, power drifts, and terrain response during arcade gameplay.
Through the Developer Alliance program, Logitech G collaborates with game developers to integrate haptic and peripheral features directly into active titles.
